Receive [[Devona]]'s services as a [[hero]].

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
| reforged = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk with [[Devona]] again.

===Reward===
* 100 [[Experience]]
* Devona joins your party.

==Walkthrough==
Speak with [[Devona]] in [[Lion's Arch]] to receive the quest, then again to complete it.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Devona'''
: ''"I am Devona, a [[Warrior]] of [[Ascalon]]. You? Yes, I've heard of you. Your reputation precedes you. In fact, when I arrived in Lion's Arch, I was hoping our paths might cross.''

: ''I would ask something of you. '''Let us form an alliance.''' I hail from a place torn asunder by violence and war. That is why I fight all the more vigorously for a just world. But don't take my word for it, friend. I prefer to let my hammer do the talking."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Very well. We should travel together.
|decline = I can't risk you slowing me down. }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Devona'''
: ''"A battle is often won or lost before the first weapon is drawn. However, a companionship is forged like hot iron upon the anvil; blow by blow, according to patience and intention. I look forward to what we can achieve together."''

==Notes==
{{anomaly|This quest is available even to characters that have already unlocked Devona as a hero through completion of [[The Scourge Beneath]] in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]].}}
